message: The other day, we had a surprise blackout that lasted a few hours. At first, I thought, "Oh no, what now?" But then I remembered my trusty power bank and flashlight stash! I gathered my family around, lit up the room with my lantern, and we ended up playing board games by the glow. It turned into a cozy little adventure instead of a hassle! 😊 Have you ever turned a blackout into something fun? I'd love to hear your tips!
